title: Exotic

inlines.v: EXOT'IC, adjective [Gr. without.] Foreign; pertaining to or produced in a foreign country; not native; extraneous; as an exotic plant; an exotic term or word. EXOT'IC, noun A plant, shrub or tree not native; a plant produced in a foreign country. 1. A word of foreign origin.
